opening.argument: The speaker actively directs viewers toward paid participation: he tells them to buy mining shares and identifies a $500 option, then links accumulating more shares to obtaining more profit. He also offers a referral for joining the program, tying participation to the prospect of income through mining returns. Although the video shows earnings initially at zero and includes ordinary signup steps, those details do not change the central solicitation to join, purchase mining participation, and pursue returns through the program.
